skill.name: popup-cro
skill.description: Design and optimize respectful conversion popups, modals, slide-ins, overlays, and banners for lead capture, promotions, announcements, and retention.
skill.summary: Guides popup strategy, copy, targeting, timing, testing, compliance, and accessibility for conversion-focused overlays.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

security_audit.summary: The two static findings are false positives caused by ordinary popup optimization guidance. SKILL.md recommends easy dismissal and non-manipulative decline copy, with no evidence of reconnaissance, command execution, prompt injection, or data exfiltration.

static_findings.snippet: - Avoid manipulative: "No, I don't want to save money"

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 222 advises against manipulative popup decline text. It contains no system reconnaissance behavior or instruction to inspect host details.
Line 49 says popups should be easy to dismiss. This is user experience guidance, not network reconnaissance or any network access instruction.

content.value_statement: Poorly timed popups can interrupt visitors and lower trust. This skill helps design respectful popups with clear offers, targeting, testing, and accessibility rules.
actual_capabilities: Recommends popup types for email capture, lead magnets, discounts, announcements, and exit intent.
Defines trigger rules using time, scroll depth, page count, behavior, and click intent.
Creates popup copy structures for headlines, subheads, calls to action, and decline options.
Advises on frequency caps, audience targeting, page exclusions, and conflict rules.
Provides measurement plans with conversion, close, engagement, and submission metrics.
Includes accessibility, mobile, privacy, and intrusive interstitial guidance.
limitations: Does not implement popup code or connect to marketing platforms.
Requires traffic, audience, and offer context for precise recommendations.
Cannot guarantee conversion lift without testing and enough sample size.
Does not replace legal review for privacy, consent, or accessibility obligations.

use_cases.title: Improve an Ecommerce Discount Popup
use_cases.description: Create a first-purchase offer with better timing, clear copy, and respectful frequency caps.

use_cases.title: Plan a SaaS Lead Magnet Modal
use_cases.description: Turn a gated resource into a click-triggered popup with focused copy and minimal fields.

use_cases.title: Audit a Publisher Newsletter Overlay
use_cases.description: Review scroll triggers, mobile behavior, close options, and metrics for a content subscription popup.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Popup
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a single campaign.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a popup for [site type] that promotes [offer]. Recommend the popup type, trigger, copy, CTA, close option, and frequency cap.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize an Existing Popup
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve performance using current campaign details.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this popup: [copy, design, trigger, target audience, device mix, metrics]. Identify conversion issues and recommend practical improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-Popup Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a popup strategy for [business]. Include entry, scroll, exit, and click-triggered popups with audience rules and conflict prevention.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Popup Experiments
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced testing plan for measurable improvement.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an experiment roadmap for [popup goal]. Include hypotheses, variants, success metrics, guardrails, sample considerations, and rollout criteria.

output_examples.input: I need an email popup for a skincare store with a 10 percent first-order discount.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: Use a scroll-based email capture modal after 40 percent page depth. Lead with the discount, keep one email field, show once per session, and suppress it for purchasers.

output_examples.input: Our exit popup has a high close rate and low submissions.
output_examples.output: Likely issues: weak offer relevance, early trigger conflict, or friction in the form. Test clearer value copy, fewer fields, and a stronger exit-specific offer.

output_examples.input: We want a newsletter overlay for blog readers without hurting mobile SEO.
output_examples.output: Use a non-blocking slide-in after meaningful scroll depth. Keep the close button visible, avoid full-screen mobile interstitials, and track close rate by device.

best_practices: Match the popup offer to the page context and visitor intent.
Make dismissal obvious, remembered, and accessible on every device.
Measure both conversions and negative signals such as close rate and complaints.
anti_patterns: Showing a full-screen popup before visitors see the page content.
Using guilt-based decline copy or hiding the close control.
Running multiple popups without audience rules, frequency caps, or conflict logic.

faq.question: What popup types does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers modals, overlays, slide-ins, announcement banners, email capture popups, lead magnets, discounts, and exit intent popups.

faq.question: Can it write the popup copy?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft headlines, subheads, CTA text, decline options, and offer framing.

faq.question: Does it include mobile guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends mobile-friendly formats, larger touch targets, visible close controls, and alternatives to desktop exit intent.

faq.question: Can it help with compliance?
faq.answer: It provides practical privacy and accessibility checks, but legal obligations still need qualified review.

faq.question: Does it handle A/B testing plans?
faq.answer: Yes. It suggests hypotheses, variants, metrics, and guardrails for popup experiments.

faq.question: Is this only for ecommerce?
faq.answer: No. It also supports SaaS, content, media, lead generation, and announcement use cases.
